reviews.review:
Highly recommended for anyone who is into strategy games.
As a fan of starcraft/warcraft/AOE2 I was surprised by how fun the difficulty curve is in this game, it seems very easy to learn at first but quickly ramps up with elements that make each level very replayable.

I got caught off guard by the cute pixel art, thinking it would be a breeze after the first level, now I find myself replaying the same harder levels multiple times without regret to optimize my zombie spread.

The gameplay loop is well executed and it shows they've put a lot of thought into it.

As an early access game, I expected it to have some bugs and other issues, but the game is actually extremely solid, everything that is released is well tested and works. The early access really just focuses on the roadmap for all planned additions, and I am very excited to see what new changes and additions are in store for the game.

Definitely worth it at the current pricetag, you won't regret it.
